hooks.text: Every single day since November 2000, humans have lived in space.
When was the last day no human was living off Earth?
You might assume humans only visit space for brief temporary missions.

title: The 24-Year Streak of Living Off Earth
description: Since Expedition 1 boarded the International Space Station in November 2000, humanity has maintained an unbroken streak of living in space every single day.

beats.text: Every single day since November 2000, humans have lived in space.
beats.visual: Wide view of the International Space Station orbiting Earth, 2021
queries: International Space Station in orbit Earth

beats.text: Many people assume space stations are only occupied during brief astronaut visits.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle payload bay in orbit around Earth, 1998

beats.text: On October 31, 2000, three men launched aboard a Soyuz rocket from Kazakhstan.
beats.visual: Soyuz TM-31 rocket launch at Baikonur Cosmodrome, 2000

beats.text: Former U.S. Navy SEAL William Shepherd and cosmonauts Yuri Gidzenko and Sergei Krikalev docked two days later.
beats.visual: Portrait of Expedition 1 crew members in space suits, 2000
queries: Expedition 1 crew portrait Shepherd Gidzenko Krikalev

beats.text: Shepherd invoked naval tradition to give their new orbital outpost the call sign Alpha.
beats.visual: Interior of the Zvezda Service Module on the International Space Station, 2000

card.small: station call sign requested by Shepherd

beats.text: Over 136 days, the crew activated basic life support systems and received massive solar arrays.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Endeavour delivering solar arrays to the ISS during STS-97, 2000

beats.text: In February 2001, Space Shuttle Atlantis delivered the 1.4 billion dollar Destiny research module.
beats.visual: Canadarm installing Destiny Laboratory Module onto the space station during STS-98, 2001

beats.text: When Expedition 1 handed over control in March 2001, they secured continuous orbital living.
beats.visual: Expedition 1 and Expedition 2 crews together aboard the space station, 2001

beats.text: That unbroken chain ensures someone is always residing above the atmosphere.
beats.visual: Earth horizon from International Space Station cupola window, 2020
queries: view of Earth from space station cupola

better_than_last: Applies the myth_vs_fact structure to contrast common beliefs about temporary space missions with the unbroken 24-year human habitation chain since Expedition 1.
